profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer who enjoys both making things and learning what makes things work. Big fan of open source contribution. Advocate of everything TypeScript, and passionate about granular Redis monitoring via RediSomm.

🗣 Presenter at Single Sprout Speaker Series '22 | Containers, Container Orchestration, and Kubernetes
📝 How to Track Individual Keyspace Misses in Your Redis Databases | Medium

Find me on GitHub https://github.com/cartersamj

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer working on content management pipelines - event driven docker services in C# fronted by React

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Used TypeScript’s strong static typing throughout the product to decrease runtime errors, create a self-documenting codebase, and improve developer collaboration
• Formulated tests with Jest and Supertest frameworks, while adhering to Test-Driven Development principles to test, maintain, and ensure a consistent and accurate development process
• Utilized React, with React Router – to prevent costly re-renders and database reads after page navigation – and React Hooks – for state-management flexibility and re-render predictability – as the front-end for Electron application
• Leveraged Redis’ inherent message-broker functionality and pub/sub channels to track individual keyspace hits and keyspace misses to be used for monitoring data generated from Redis itself
• Implemented Next.js for its intuitive page routing, quick and SEO-friendly static-site generation, and built in API functionality to use as both a landing page and frame for the web app
• Constructed backend functionality with Express, utilizing its REST-friendly architecture and middleware design philosophy to handle requests to appropriate API endpoints and elegantly exchange data between two databases
• Built app with Electron for native compatibility with Node.js and React, stable and industry-standard pedigree for desktop web apps, and ease of porting to a full web application without extra configuration
• Used a NoSQL database for its quick lookup time and capability to store nested objects for tracking granular data from the monitored Redis database
• Wrote both Docker and Docker Compose .yaml files to containerize and ship the executable for Windows, MacOS, and Linux Ubuntu, and built a dev environment container for easy remote developer collaboration
• Structured and used webpack for its config file’s flexibility with changing developer environments, hot module reloading and TypeScript support to ensure a responsive and fine-tuned developer experience
• Developed under tech accelerator OSLabs

positions.title: Path10x | Developer Stack and Technology Tracker
positions.description:
• Used a SQL database, for need of ACID-compliant relational vinyl record data, to store data from a third party API and ensure flexibility when querying for data
• Applied Jest, Supertest, and React Testing Library with test-driven development principles to streamline the testing environment to minimize bugs and development time

positions.title: Serengeti | Vinyl Record E-Commerce App
positions.description:
•Used a NoSQL database for its quick-lookup speed and document model to store user data and account information
•Implemented bcrypt’s key strengthening hashing algorithm to encrypt sensitive user data and protect against rainbow tables and dictionary attacks

positions.title: Barcart | Home Bar Inventory and Cocktail Suggester App
positions.description: • Configured webpack for faster load times, hot module reloading, ES6+ transpilation for developer packages, and leveraged minification and uglification features to decrease bundled file size
